summary: 8 scene layout packs delivered: layout_top.png (true-orthographic plan, 2560x1440, no people, text or arrows) + layout.json (scene_layout.v1, landmarks calibrated to the image with xy and xy_m, 9 views) + prompts.json + notes.md. The 9-view grid was not generated (retired 2026-09-09). Host check scene_layout_pack_ok PASS on all 8. 4 images carry major deviations kept for the H2 decision (auto-retry = 0).

style_inputs.register: dream register for 6 dream scenes (full Mucha); waking register for SCN-riverbank and SCN-field-hedge-burrow (no ornament, per CR-014 / style_anchors_by_register)
style_inputs.negatives: negative_prompt_en verbatim + a top-down projection negative list; + negative_prompt_waking_addon_en for the 2 waking scenes

user_refs.used_as: Look reference, applied through text. The style_fragment_ui and dream register already encode its palette, ironwork, mosaic, roundels, patina, moss and amber/teal light, and the plan prompts name those materials.
user_refs.why_not_injected: It is an eye-level perspective interior with a girl and the Caterpillar. As a --ref on a plan view it pulls the camera off nadir (elevation and perspective prior) and pushes figures and creatures into an image that must have none. For the waking scenes it would also leak Art Nouveau into the no-ornament register. For shot plates (eye-level), downstream may inject it.

acceptance.scene_layout_pack_ok: PASS x8. Command: code/blocking_map_check.py --project alices --scene <id>. It was run with the app runtime python3.12, because the system python3 lacks PIL and could only WARN on the image size; with python3.12: 0 violations, 0 WARN.
acceptance.views_self_check: PASS x8 after image calibration, via code/p4-env-concept-sb1_views_check.py: angles in {eye, low, high_oblique}, no top-down wording, unique camera pairs, looking_at <= 3, wide <= 4, close+detail >= 2, low >= 1, max 3 views per +-30 deg sector (aspect-corrected bearings).
acceptance.image_clean: No people, animals, text, labels or arrows in any of the 8 images (visual check)
acceptance.prompt_record: prompts.json in each scene dir (prompt, negative, size, n, provider/model, user_refs)
